codebuddy.versionPolicy: verify --help flags once in setup; reuse compatible executable; otherwise install managed official latest
codebuddy.verification: require SHA256 equal to official checksums.txt before extract and execute
codebuddy.login: official interactive /login opened in Terminal via .command
codebuddy.credentials: managed by official CLI only; never copied into app or package
codebuddy.replacementPolicy: never overwrite global CLI; replace only managed binary with retained unique backup
